LightningComponentBundle.description: Generate documents from any record — PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint. Works on desktop and mobile.

property.name: showSaveAndDownloadOption
property.label: Show Save & Download Option
property.description: Offers the combined Save-to-Record-and-Download destination. Only appears when Download and Save to Record are both enabled.

property.name: showCombineWithExistingPdfsOption
property.label: Show Combine with Existing PDFs Option

property.name: recordPickerObject
property.label: Record Search Object API Name
property.description: Lets users search for the record to generate against — e.g. Account, Opportunity, My_Object__c. Leave blank to use the fixed Record ID below instead. Set one or the other, not both.

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record ID (fixed)
property.description: Optional. Always generate against this one record. When set, the search box does not appear — clear this field to let users choose their own record.

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name (for fixed Record ID)
property.description: Object API name of the fixed Record ID above. Not needed when using record search.

property.name: showSaveAndDownloadOption
property.label: Show Save & Download Option
property.description: Offers the combined Save-to-Record-and-Download destination. Only appears when Download and Save to Record are both enabled.

property.name: showCombineWithExistingPdfsOption
property.label: Show Combine with Existing PDFs Option

property.name: recordPickerObject
property.label: Record Search Object API Name
property.description: Optional. When no Record ID is passed in, lets the user search for one — e.g. Account.

property.name: showSaveAndDownloadOption
property.label: Show Save & Download Option
property.description: Offers the combined Save-to-Record-and-Download destination. Only appears when Download and Save to Record are both enabled.

property.name: showCombineWithExistingPdfsOption
property.label: Show Combine with Existing PDFs Option

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record ID
property.description: Record ID to generate against. Bind to {!recordId} when placed on a record-detail community page, or set a fixed Id for a public landing page.

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: Object API name for the recordId. Optional — engine resolves from the Id prefix when blank.

property.name: showDownloadOption
property.label: Show Download Option
property.description: Community users typically download. Leave on.

property.name: showSaveToRecordOption
property.label: Show Save to Record Option
property.description: Save back to records is internal-context only. Leave off for community placements.

property.name: showSaveAndDownloadOption
property.label: Show Save & Download Option
property.description: Combined Save-to-Record-and-Download destination. Internal-context only — leave off for community placements.

property.name: showDocumentPacketOption
property.label: Show Document Packet Mode
property.description: Multi-template packets are an internal admin feature. Leave off for self-service portals.
